metadata.question: Does the water 100 km south of Bear Island, Norway show more milky turquoise-blue color than that 250 km south of Bear Island on August 5, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need Sentinel-2 imagery (best for true color/visual assessment) - Date: August 5, 2025 - Locations: 100 km south and 250 km south of Bear Island, Norway - Bear Island (Bjørnøya) is at approximately 74.5°N, 19°E - 100 km south: ~73.6°N, 19°E - 250 km south: ~72.25°N, 19°E 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we need clear water observations - Need QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 3. Logic: - "Milky turquoise-blue" suggests higher reflectance in blue/green bands with sediment - Can use band ratios or direct RGB values - Calculate a turbidity-like metric: (Blue + Green) / Red ratio - Or use blue band reflectance as proxy - Compare the two locations - Valid result = A (yes, more turquoise at 100km) or B (no) - C1 = no images found - C2 = images exist but no valid pixels after masking - C3 = calculation fails (None/NaN) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Bear Island coordinates: ~74.5°N, 19°E // 100 km south: approximately 0.9 degrees south // 250 km south: approximately 2.25 degrees south const point100km = ee.Geometry.Point([19.0, 73.6]); const point250km = ee.Geometry.Point([19.0, 72.25]); const buffer = 5000; // 5km buffer for sampling const region100 = point100km.buffer(buffer); const region250 = point250km.buffer(buffer); const startDate = '2025-08-04'; const endDate = '2025-08-06'; // Cloud masking function function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask).divide(10000); } // Get Sentinel-2 data let col100 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region100) .map(maskS2clouds); let col250 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(region250) .map(maskS2clouds); const size100 = col100.size().getInfo(); const size250 = col250.size().getInfo(); console.log(`100km location: ${size100} images`); console.log(`250km location: ${size250} images`); if (size100 === 0 || size250 === 0) { console.log('No imagery found for one or both locations.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get median composite const img100 = col100.median(); const img250 = col250.median(); // Calculate turbidity metric: (Blue + Green) for milky turquoise color // Higher values indicate more sediment/glacial meltwater (turquoise-blue color) const turquoise100 = img100.select('B2').add(img100.select('B3')); const turquoise250 = img250.select('B2').add(img250.select('B3')); // Check pixel counts const count100 = turquoise100.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region100, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); const count250 = turquoise250.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region250, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); console.log(`100km valid pixels: ${count100}`); console.log(`250km valid pixels: ${count250}`); if (count100 === 0 || count250 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate mean turquoise values const val100 = turquoise100.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region100, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); const val250 = turquoise250.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region250, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); console.log(`100km turquoise index: ${val100}`); console.log(`250km turquoise index: ${val250}`); if (val100 === null || val250 === null || isNaN(val100) || isNaN(val250)) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare values if (val100 > val250) { console.log('100km shows more milky turquoise-blue color.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('250km shows equal or more milky turquoise-blue color.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
